mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 returns; a low rate (<= 0.5%) predicts positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is <= 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle that is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise by more than 0.1% in the last month, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rising > 0.1% in the last 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.1% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise by more than 0.1% in the last 3 months, the 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST) are associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST <= 650, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals a weak economy and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST declines by > 2% and INDPRO declines by > 1% in the last month, the 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (defined by INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 growth > 2% in the last quarter), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 growth > 2% in the last quarter
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100 and GDPC1 growth > 2% in the last quarter, the 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 50% of cases.
